user.description: Make python-kasa log in with KLAP v2 to Kasa plugs and switches whose firmware advertises login version 2 (for example the EP10 on firmware 1.1.1). Without it those devices reject correct TP-Link credentials. Other devices are unaffected.

incompatible.title: Kasa KLAP v2 can't apply its change
incompatible.description: The installed python-kasa no longer matches what this integration patches, so it does nothing. Check whether Kasa devices with login version 2 connect without it; if they do, remove it.

not_needed.title: Kasa KLAP v2 is no longer needed
not_needed.description: The installed python-kasa already uses KLAP v2 for devices that advertise login version 2. You can remove this integration.
